readme.section: Introduction
readme.text:
dsh-lesson-loop

Guard denials, gate failures and human thumb-downs become project lessons; only a rule a human confirmed is injected back into the model at session start.

Introduction
readme.text: **A self-evolution loop for [dsh](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): one lesson bus the guard plugins report to, one rule library a human curates, and armed rules injected into every new session of their project.**

readme.section: What it does
readme.text:
- **One bus, no coupling.** Sibling plugins report through the optional `lessonLoop` service; a profile without this package only drops those reports. The host half provides the service, the client half renders a web card holding the switches and the rule review desk.
- **Sink.** Each report appends one line to the event stream and merges into a candidate card keyed by (project, category, signature); at `promoteThreshold` that key is marked ready for review.
- **A machine never promotes a rule.** Status `armed` is only ever a human decision — the card's `arm` action writes it, and the startup migration merely carries an existing armed state onto a merged card. `reject` / `demote` / `archive` / `edit` / `revive` are human actions too.
- **Remind.** A project-agnostic standing section keeps the loop visible, and each root session receives the full text of its project's armed rules at `agent/created`. Subagent sessions are skipped.
- **Zero model tools, zero HTTP routes of its own.** The card's data plane is the official Typert Remote namespace `lessonLoopRules`, reached through the host `/api` gateway.

readme.section: How a rule is judged
readme.text:
- Three counters answer three different questions: `violation` (the scenario fired and was broken), `suppressed` (the scenario fired and was followed, driven by `pass`), `samples` (the rule was present and not violated).
- The only ratio is `violation / (violation + suppressed)`; `samples` is exposure and never a denominator.
- `samples` counts a durable session once even when it is resumed: duplicate disposal edges are deduplicated, so reopening a session does not inflate exposure.
- Demotion needs a positive `suppressed`, `violation` at `demoteThreshold`, real evidence at `demoteMinSamples`, and the ratio at `demoteRatio`.
- A rule with zero clean hits whose scenario keeps firing is **undeterminable**: neither the ratio nor the decay can retire it, so it stays armed for a human. One `pass` clears the flag.

readme.section: Install
readme.text:
```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @jayyuen66/dsh-lesson-loop
```

Remove with `dsh plugin --profile web remove @jayyuen66/dsh-lesson-loop`. The package is on the public npm registry, so installation needs no credentials.

readme.section: Install
readme.text:
- **Node.js `>= 24.9`, host `dsh` on the rolling `^0.2.1-rc.5 || ^0.2.2-alpha.3` window.** The plugin's own floor is `engines.node` (`>=24.9.0`), which is the host's floor from `0.2.2-alpha.2` up: a host below it never starts, so a lower claim here would promise an environment nobody can install into. The requirement the host reads is `engines.dsh` (`^0.2.1-rc.5 || ^0.2.2-alpha.3`), and it **decides alone** — with that field present, `evaluatePluginCompatibility` never looks at the `@deepseek-ai/dsh*` peers. Measured: `0.2.0-rc.2`, `0.2.1-rc.1` and `0.2.1-rc.3` are refused, `0.2.1-rc.5` through `0.2.2-rc.1` pass, `0.3.0` is refused. The support window rolls: this package is verified against every released host version inside the window at publish time and re-verified once the window moves, so the version number in this bullet is not a standing promise.
- **No `@deepseek-ai/*` under `dependencies`, by contract.** Profiles install with `nodeLinker: hoisted` and `autoInstallPeers: false`, so a host package there becomes a real second copy; `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` keys its scheduler with a plain `Symbol`, so **every native tool call throws** in that profile while build, typecheck and

readme.section: Shared version floor
readme.text: If your profile pins `@jayyuen66/dsh-plugin-shared` with a pnpm `overrides` entry, that pin must be at least the version this package declares. A lower pin installs a copy without the names imported at runtime, and the host then reports `N entries did not activate` together with `does not provide an export named ...` at boot — the package installs fine and never loads, and no per-repository CI run can see it.

readme.section: Verify it is live
readme.text:
1. **The layer is mounted.** `dsh --profile web --dump-config` ends with `# == @jayyuen66/dsh-lesson-loop` plus `- id: lesson-loop`.
   - That command is the only accepted signal, and it is **not read-only** — it rewrites the profile's root assembly file. Read layer lines from stdout **and** check stderr separately: an unmatched patch target appears only on stderr, so the exit code alone proves nothing. Accept both `# == <layer>` and `# == <layer>, patched by <path>`.
2. **The card renders live data.** Its header carries the current candidate / armed / lesson counts and opening it fills the rule groups. A plain "stats unavailable" row means the layer is mounted but the Remote namespace did not reach the browser; the longer localized host error ("stats unavailable: the host read path failed — retry") means the namespace is live and that one read failed, so retry after the read path recovers.
3. **A lesson reaches the library.** Trigger one denial or gate failure from an installed reporter (danger-guard, quality-gate, session-rescue), or run `/lessons-digest` in a session with negative feedback; the candidate group gains evidence.

readme.section: What it does not provide
readme.text:
- **No model tools.** There is no `lesson_report` tool; the surface is the service plus the card's namespace.
- **No HTTP route of its own.** Authentication, Host / DNS-rebinding / Origin checks and body limits are the host gateway's.
- **No CLI subcommand.** The only command it contributes is the in-session `/lessons-digest`.
- **No outbound request of its own.** The distillation call goes through the host `llm` service.
- **No self-re-enabling rules.** A `rejected` card may return to `candidate` at the revive threshold; only a human can arm it again.

readme.section: Enabling it in dsh
readme.text:
- `dsh.bundle.patch` points at `cordis.patch.yml`, which carries **two entries**: `- name: "@jayyuen66/dsh-plugin-shared"` (the supplier of the card components, deliberately **without an `id`** so the plugin page does not list it as a switchable component) and `- id: lesson-loop` with `name: "@jayyuen66/dsh-lesson-loop"`. The **bare package name** is what makes the host scan the client half.
- **One entry, one `Config`.** The settings namespace is the entry id, so switches, thresholds and the `rules` array share one section and one revision. `rules` carries `.loose()`, the read side checks the raw shape through `describe().user` (unreadable means it refuses to write rather than overwriting), and every write is one CAS commit with re-read and replay.
- `settings` is the only plugin-level hard dependency. `timer` / `commands` / `systemPrompt` / `llm` are optional: a missing one removes that capability, the plugin still loads.
- The card's data plane is installed unconditionally on the apply fiber, so it exists even on a host whose web layer arrives late.
- `locale/en.json` / `locale/zh.json` supply the plugin page's `meta.title`, `meta.description` and `meta.detail`; the detail page

readme.section: Enabling it in dsh
readme.text:
```sh
dsh plugin --profile web allow-version @jayyuen66/dsh-lesson-loop@<version> --dsh-version <exact running host version> --accept-risk
```

`version-exemptions` lists the grants and `revoke-version` removes one; `--dsh-version` must equal the version the running host reports.

readme.section: The lesson bus
readme.text:
| Method                                        | Purpose                                                                                                                 |
| --------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `report(input)`                               | Append a lesson, merge it into that key's card; returns `{ ok, reason?, violationOf?, candidate?, ready?, justReady? }` |
| `pass(input)`                                 | The rule's scenario fired and was followed; counted as `suppressed` when the session ends                               |
| `rules()` / `recentLessons(project?, limit?)` | Read the rule library / the event stream                                                                                |
| `ruleAction(id, action, statement?)`          | The six human actions                                                                                                   |
| `stats()`                                     | Counters and the config summary behind the card

readme.section: The lesson bus
readme.text:
- `reason` is one of `disabled`, `rules-not-persisted` (this change did not reach the library — retry) or `error`. It is a receipt code, not translated text.
- `source` is an open set: `danger-guard`, `quality-gate`, `session-rescue`, `lessons-digest` and `manual` are built in, and a third party may name itself freely (trimmed, non-empty, ≤ 64 characters, else `manual` with a log line). Two report kinds carry meaning worth naming: `gate-not-run` marks a check that never ran, because an environment problem must not be learned as a code lesson, and `needsUserConfirmation: true` in the evidence marks a judgement the reporter could not make — evidence, but no violation.
- Path-shaped categories fold into category-level keys (`edit-before-factgate`, `edit-before-secret-path`, `dangerous-bash`), so one general lesson does not shatter into per-file cards. The concrete target stays in the evidence: `signature` for `secret-path` and `dangerous-bash`, `target` for `factgate-deny` (which reports the folded key as its signature).
- Callers should go through `settleLessonCall` from `@jayyuen66/dsh-plugin-shared/lib/lesson-bus`, which routes sync throws and async rejections to one exit.

readme.section: Settings
readme.text: Namespace = the entry id `lesson-loop`. Four switches default to `true`: `enabled` (master — off means no reporting, injection, exit settlement or standing section, periodic decay pauses, and `/lessons-digest` refuses), `reportEnabled` (lesson **entry** gate: it stops `report()` and `/lessons-digest` only — `pass()` accounting and the dispose-time settlement follow `enabled` alone), `injectEnabled`, `sectionEnabled`.

readme.section: Settings
readme.text:
| Field               | Default    | Range              | Purpose                                                                                                                             |
| ------------------- | ---------- | ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `promoteThreshold`  | `3`        | 1–20               | Same-key lessons reaching this count mark the card for review                                                                       |
| `demoteThreshold`   | `3`        | 1–50               | Violations after arming required to demote                                                                                          |
| `demoteMinSamples`  | `5`        | 1–100              | Minimum real evidence `violation + suppressed`                                                                                      |
| `demoteRatio`       | `0.5`      | 0.05–1 (step 0.05) | Recurrence-ratio red line                                                                                                           |
| `decayDays`         | `30`       | 1–365

readme.section: Settings
readme.text: The last three rows are deployment values: not `.volatile()`, so the card has no row for them and they are given only on the registration line's `config:`, taking effect on restart.

readme.section: Public interface
readme.text:
| Method                | Input                        | Reply                                                                                                                                         |
| --------------------- | ---------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `stats()`             | —                            | `{ ok: true, …counters, …config summary, rules }`; the rule projection carries the derived `undeterminable` flag and **no** `evidence` bodies |
| `rules(request)`      | `{ project? }`               | `{ ok: true, rules }`; a non-string `project` reads as absent, i.e. the whole library                                                         |
| `lessons(request)`    | `{ project?, limit? }`       | `{ ok: true, count, lessons }`; an absent, non-finite or ≤ 0 `limit` means the default 50, and an explicit value is capped at 500             |
| `ruleAction(request)` | `{ id, action, statement? }` | `{ ok: true, id, action }`, or `{ ok: false, error, status }`

readme.section: Public interface
readme.text:
- `action` must be one of the six whitelisted values; `statement` is read by `arm` and `edit` only, trimmed, and a blank string counts as "not given". A statement longer than `maxStatementChars` returns `{ ok: false, status: 400 }` and the library stays untouched.
- A refusal's `status` is a **retained semantic code, not an HTTP status**: 400 for a missing field or an off-whitelist action, 404 for an unknown card, 500 for a change the library refused to persist (carrying `rules-not-persisted`).
- The read methods return `{ ok: false, error, status: 500 }` when the host read path fails; `error` is localized and the original exception stays in the host log. A 500 here means the read failed, not that the request was malformed.
- Reads are pulled, not pushed: on panel open, after a save, and after each manual action. There is no polling loop and no client-side wall clock.

readme.section: Data and privacy
readme.text:
| Aspect               | Content                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| -------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Written to disk      | The event stream at `$DSH_HOME/cache/lesson-loop/events.jsonl` (a discardable derived-data location) plus its transient `.lock` / `.tmp` siblings, and the `rules` array in the `lesson-loop` section of the settings document          |
| Network              | No call of its own. `/lessons-digest` sends this session's negative feedback and the project's recent lessons to the current default model through the host `llm` service, so that content leaves the machine when that model is remote |
| Retention            | The event stream keeps details and rule statements in full, with zero truncation; `maxLessonsBytes` is a disk fuse, not a context cap

readme.section: Known boundaries
readme.text:
- **Nothing is promoted automatically** — a rule that armed itself would turn one noisy report into a permanent instruction.
- **Undeterminable rules do not converge**: with no clean hit there is no denominator, so only a human retires them, and the injection cap keeps that population out of the context.
- **Subagent sessions are skipped** — a second injection would count as exposure for a rule they never saw.
- **The card is pull-based**, so a value cached across a reconnect would be stale by design.
- **Evidence bodies stay out of the card**: the `lessons()` read face may carry a lesson's `detail`, capped at 400 characters, and the card renders only the signature and the counters.
- **No machine translation**: rule statements and evidence are user data.
- **Optional services remove capabilities, not the plugin**: no `commands` means no `/lessons-digest`, no `systemPrompt` means no standing section, no `llm` means the digest refuses, no `timer` leaves manual review only; without `settings` the entry never activates and the startup diagnostic names it.
- **A digest run can partially fail**: cards that did not reach the library are reported separately, and the receipt never claims "

readme.section: Development
readme.text:
- `test/` splits by the class of defect a stub cannot see: unit tests drive the store and the pure helpers; `test/integration/` drives a real cordis and loader, so service hand-out, sibling `inject` resolution, activation order and bulkhead isolation are measured rather than mocked.
- Two artifact gates: `test/build-host.test.ts` holds the cross-package imports external as bare specifiers, `test/dist-size.test.ts` a size budget, so an inlined dependency cannot pass unnoticed. `test/publish-manifest.test.ts` guards the published shape — entry targets covered by `files`, no source file as an entry point, host packages absent from `dependencies`, `dsh-*` pins exact and uniform, no dates in comments or documents.
- Coverage thresholds are 100% across four metrics, so a new branch needs a case that reaches it.

readme.section: 它做什么
readme.text:
- **一条总线，无耦合。** 兄弟插件经可选的 `lessonLoop` 服务上报；没装本包的 profile 只是丢掉这些上报。host 半提供这个服务，client 半渲染带开关与规则评审台的 web 设置卡。
- **沉淀。** 每次上报往事件流追加一行，并按 (project, category, signature) 归并进一张候选卡；同键达到 `promoteThreshold` 时，这张卡被标为待评审。
- **机器永不升格规则。** 状态 `armed` 只可能来自人工决定——卡片上的 `arm` 动作写它，启动时的迁移只是把既有的 armed 状态搬到归并后的主卡上。`reject` / `demote` / `archive` / `edit` / `revive` 同样是人工动作。
- **提醒。** 一段与项目无关的常驻段让回路一直可见，每个根会话在 `agent/created` 时收到本项目 armed 规则的全文。子代理会话跳过。
- **零模型工具，零自有 HTTP 路由。** 卡片的数据面是官方 Typert Remote 命名空间 `lessonLoopRules`，经宿主 `/api` 网关访问。

readme.section: 规则如何判定
readme.text:
- 三个计数器回答三个不同的问题：`violation`（场景触发且被违反）、`suppressed`（场景触发且被遵守，由 `pass` 驱动）、`samples`（规则在场且未被违反）。
- 唯一的比值是 `violation / (violation + suppressed)`；`samples` 是暴露数，永不进分母。
- `samples` 按 durable 会话计一次：同一会话被 resume 产生的重复 disposed 边会被去重，重开不会虚增暴露数。
- 降级需要 `suppressed` 为正、`violation` 达到 `demoteThreshold`、真实证据达到 `demoteMinSamples`，且比值达到 `demoteRatio`。
- 场景一直触发却零干净命中的规则是**不可判定**：比值与衰减都退不掉它，于是它一直保持 armed，等人工处置。一次 `pass` 即清除该标记。

readme.section: 安装
readme.text:
- **Node.js `>= 24.9`、宿主 `dsh` 在滚动的 `^0.2.1-rc.5 || ^0.2.2-alpha.3` 窗口上。** 插件自己的下限是 `engines.node`（`>=24.9.0`），这一档取自宿主：`0.2.2` 系列从 `alpha.2` 起每一版宿主都声明 Node `>=24.9.0`，写得更低等于承诺一个宿主起不来的运行环境。宿主读取的版本要求是 `engines.dsh`（`^0.2.1-rc.5 || ^0.2.2-alpha.3`），而且它**单独决定**——这个字段在时，`evaluatePluginCompatibility` 从不看 `@deepseek-ai/dsh*` 这批 peer。实测：`0.2.0-rc.2`、`0.2.1-rc.1` 与 `0.2.1-rc.3` 被拒，`0.2.1-rc.5` 到 `0.2.2-rc.1`（含 `0.2.2-alpha.3`）通过，`0.3.0` 被拒。支持窗口是滚动的：本包在发布时把窗口内的每个已发布宿主版本逐版取证，窗口滚动后重新取证，不把这一句里的版本号当长期承诺。
- **按契约，`dependencies` 下不放任何 `@deepseek-ai/*`。** profile 以 `nodeLinker: hoisted` 与 `autoInstallPeers: false` 安装，那里放一个宿主包就会变成真实的第二份副本；`@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` 用普通 `Symbol` 给调度器做键，于是那个 profile 里**每一次原生工具调用都抛错**，而构建、类型检查与覆盖率一直全绿。`host.js` 按值导入的四枚宿主包都是必需 peer，并在 `devDependencies` 里按同一个精确钉版再写一份，好让打包器把它们外部化，而不是内联官方函数体；`test/publish-manifest.test.ts` 把这两半都钉住。产物由 `prepack` 重建，从不提交。

readme.section: shared 的版本下限
readme.text: 如果你的 profile 用 pnpm `overrides` 把 `@jayyuen66/dsh-plugin-shared` 钉在某个版本，那个钉住的值必须不低于本包声明的版本。钉得更低就会装到一份缺少运行期所导入名字的副本，宿主起来时报 `N entries did not activate` 并附一句 `does not provide an export named ...`——包装得上、永远不加载，而任何单仓 CI 都看不见。

readme.section: 确认它真的在工作
readme.text:
1. **层已经进栈。** `dsh --profile web --dump-config` 末尾出现 `# == @jayyuen66/dsh-lesson-loop` 加 `- id: lesson-loop`。
   - 那条命令是唯一被接受的判据，而且它**不是只读命令**——它会重写该 profile 的根装配文件。层行要从 stdout 读，**并且**单独检查 stderr：没匹配上的 patch 目标只出现在 stderr，只看退出码证明不了任何事。两种形态都要认：`# == <layer>` 与 `# == <layer>, patched by <path>`。
2. **卡片渲染实时数据。** 它的标头带着当前的候选 / armed / 教训计数，打开后规则分组能填出内容。只出现一行「stats 不可用」说明层进了栈，但 Remote 命名空间没到浏览器；若出现的是带宿主读面说明的「stats unavailable: the host read path failed — retry」（中文界面为「读不到统计：宿主侧读面出错，请重试」），则命名空间已到，失败的是这一次读取，读面恢复后重试即可。
3. **一条教训进得了规则库。** 用装好的上报方（danger-guard、quality-gate、session-rescue）触发一次拒绝或门禁失败，或在收集到人工负反馈的会话里跑 `/lessons-digest`；候选分组就会多出证据。
4. **armed 规则回得来。** 把一张卡 arm，然后在那个项目里开一个新会话：注入的那段以 `[lesson-loop] Experience rules for this project` 开头。子代理会话按设计什么也收不到。
5. **profile 里没有宿主副本。** 临时 profile 的 `node_modules/` 里只有 `@jayyuen66/`，没有 `@deepseek-ai/` 目录。

readme.section: 它不提供什么
readme.text:
- **没有模型工具。** 没有 `lesson_report` 工具；对外接口就是那个服务加上卡片的命名空间。
- **没有自有 HTTP 路由。** 认证、Host / DNS 重绑定 / Origin 判据与请求体上限都是宿主网关的。
- **没有 CLI 子命令。** 它贡献的唯一命令是会话内的 `/lessons-digest`。
- **没有自有出网请求。** 蒸馏调用走宿主 `llm` 服务。
- **没有自行重新启用的规则。** `rejected` 卡在达到 revive 阈值时可以回到 `candidate`；再次 arm 只能由人工做。

readme.section: 在 dsh 里启用
readme.text:
- `dsh.bundle.patch` 指向 `cordis.patch.yml`，里面是**两条条目**：`- name: "@jayyuen66/dsh-plugin-shared"`（卡片组件的供应行，**刻意不写 `id`**，所以插件页不会把它列成可停用组件）与 `- id: lesson-loop`，带 `name: "@jayyuen66/dsh-lesson-loop"`。让宿主去扫描 client 半的是**裸包名**。
- **一个条目，一份 `Config`。** 设置命名空间就是条目 id，于是开关、阈值与 `rules` 数组共用同一段、同一枚 revision。`rules` 带了 `.loose()`，读侧经 `describe().user` 检查原文形状（读不懂就拒写，而不是覆写），每次写都是一次 CAS 提交加重读重放。
- `settings` 是唯一插件级硬依赖。`timer` / `commands` / `systemPrompt` / `llm` 可选：缺一个只让对应能力消失，插件照常装载。
- 卡片的数据面在 apply fiber 上无条件安装，所以即使宿主的 web 层到得晚，它也在。
- `locale/en.json` / `locale/zh.json` 提供插件页的 `meta.title`、`meta.description` 与 `meta.detail`；详情页英文读 `docs/DETAIL.md`、中文读 `docs/DETAIL.zh.md`。README 不是那一页的来源。
- 部署默认值写在注册行的 `config:` 上（卡片值 > 行 `config` > schema 默认值）；配置不合法只让这个条目的 fiber 失败。
- 不兼容的宿主按精确版本逐条授权，绝不靠放宽范围：

readme.section: 在 dsh 里启用
readme.text:
```sh
dsh plugin --profile web allow-version @jayyuen66/dsh-lesson-loop@<version> --dsh-version <exact running host version> --accept-risk
```

`version-exemptions` 列出这些授权，`revoke-version` 撤销其中一条；`--dsh-version` 必须等于运行中宿主自报的版本。

readme.section: 教训总线
readme.text:
| 方法                                          | 用途                                                                                                 |
| --------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `report(input)`                               | 追加一条教训并归并进该键的卡片；返回 `{ ok, reason?, violationOf?, candidate?, ready?, justReady? }` |
| `pass(input)`                                 | 规则对应的场景触发且被遵守；会话结束时计为 `suppressed`                                              |
| `rules()` / `recentLessons(project?, limit?)` | 读规则库 / 读事件流                                                                                  |
| `ruleAction(id, action, statement?)`          | 那六个人工动作                                                                                       |
| `stats()`                                     | 卡片背后的计数器与配置摘要                                                                           |

readme.section: 教训总线
readme.text:
- `reason` 是 `disabled`、`rules-not-persisted`（这次改动没进规则库——重试）或 `error` 三者之一。它是回执码，不是翻译过的文案。
- `source` 是开放集：`danger-guard`、`quality-gate`、`session-rescue`、`lessons-digest` 与 `manual` 是内置的，第三方可以自报名字（trim 后非空、不超过 64 字符，否则按 `manual` 记账并留一行日志）。有两种上报值得点名：`gate-not-run` 标记一次从未跑成的检查，因为环境问题不许被学成代码教训；证据里的 `needsUserConfirmation: true` 标记上报方做不了的判断——是证据，但不是违反。
- 路径形态的类别折叠到类别级键（`edit-before-factgate`、`edit-before-secret-path`、`dangerous-bash`），于是一条通用教训不会按文件碎成几十张卡。具体目标是哪个，证据里仍看得出来：`secret-path` 与 `dangerous-bash` 落在 `signature`，`factgate-deny` 落在 `target`（它上报的签名本身就是折叠后的键）。
- 调用方应经 `@jayyuen66/dsh-plugin-shared/lib/lesson-bus` 的 `settleLessonCall`，它把同步抛错与异步拒绝归到同一个出口。

readme.section: 设置项
readme.text: 命名空间 = 条目 id `lesson-loop`。四个开关默认都是 `true`：`enabled`（总开关——关掉即不上报、不注入、不做退出清算、没有常驻段、周期衰减暂停，且 `/lessons-digest` 拒绝执行）、`reportEnabled`（教训**入口**闸门：只停 `report()` 与 `/lessons-digest`——pass 记账与退出清算只随 `enabled`）、`injectEnabled`、`sectionEnabled`。

readme.section: 设置项
readme.text:
| 字段                | 默认值     | 取值范围            | 作用                                                                                        |
| ------------------- | ---------- | ------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `promoteThreshold`  | `3`        | 1–20                | 同键教训达到此次数即把卡片标为待评审                                                        |
| `demoteThreshold`   | `3`        | 1–50                | 升格后被违反到此次数才降级                                                                  |
| `demoteMinSamples`  | `5`        | 1–100               | 真实证据 `violation + suppressed` 的下限                                                    |
| `demoteRatio`       | `0.5`      | 0.05–1（步长 0.05） | 复发率红线                                                                                  |
| `decayDays`         | `30`       | 1–365               | armed 满这么久仍无干净命中，卡片转为不可判定；之后的复发不会重置窗口                        |
| `reviveThreshold`   | `3`        | 1–20                | 被拒的规则再见到此次数就回到候选                                                            |
| `maxLessonsBytes`   | `0`        | 0–1 GiB             | 磁盘保险丝；`0` = 不设上限，内容绝不为

readme.section: 设置项
readme.text: 最后三行是部署值：不标 `.volatile()`，所以卡片上没有对应的行，只能在注册行的 `config:` 上给，重启后生效。

readme.section: 对外接口
readme.text:
| 方法                  | 入参                         | 回执                                                                                                                    |
| --------------------- | ---------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `stats()`             | —                            | `{ ok: true, …counters, …config summary, rules }`；规则投影带着派生的 `undeterminable` 标记，且**不带** `evidence` 正文 |
| `rules(request)`      | `{ project? }`               | `{ ok: true, rules }`；`project` 不是字符串就按缺省读，也就是全量规则库                                                 |
| `lessons(request)`    | `{ project?, limit? }`       | `{ ok: true, count, lessons }`；`limit` 缺省、不是有限数或 ≤ 0 时取默认 50 条，显式值封顶 500                           |
| `ruleAction(request)` | `{ id, action, statement? }` | `{ ok: true, id, action }`，或 `{ ok: false, error, status }`                                                           |

readme.section: 对外接口
readme.text:
- `action` 必须是那六个白名单值之一；`statement` 只由 `arm` 与 `edit` 读取，会被 trim，空白串按「没给」处理。生效正文超过 `maxStatementChars` 时回 `{ ok: false, status: 400 }`，库不动。
- 拒绝回执里的 `status` 是**保留下来的语义码，不是 HTTP 状态**：缺字段或动作不在白名单是 400，未知的卡片是 404，规则库拒绝落盘是 500（带 `rules-not-persisted`）。
- 读方法在宿主读面失败时回 `{ ok: false, error, status: 500 }`；`error` 是本地化文案，原始异常留在宿主日志里。这里的 500 是「这次没读到」，不是请求写错了。
- 读数是拉的，不是推的：打开面板时、保存之后、每次人工动作之后各一次。这里没有轮询循环，也没有客户端墙钟。

readme.section: 数据与隐私
readme.text:
| 口径     | 内容                                                                                                                                                            |
| -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 写盘     | 事件流写在 `$DSH_HOME/cache/lesson-loop/events.jsonl`（可丢弃的派生数据位置）与它瞬时的 `.lock` / `.tmp` 兄弟文件，以及设置文档 `lesson-loop` 段的 `rules` 数组 |
| 网络     | 本包没有自己的网络调用。`/lessons-digest` 经宿主 `llm` 服务把本会话的人工差评与该项目的近期教训交给当前默认模型——那个模型在外网时，这些内容就出域了             |
| 保留     | 事件流完整保留 detail 与规则正文，零截断；`maxLessonsBytes` 是磁盘保险丝，不是上下文上限                                                                        |
| 证据收敛 | 规则卡的 `evidence` 是唯一例外：过长的 detail 截断并补省略号，每张卡只留最近的若干行，且只在落盘那一刻发生。`signature` 与计数器一律不裁                        |
| 并发     | 规则库写入带跨进程 CAS；事件流的追加与裁剪共用同一把锁                                                                                                          |
| 语言     | host 侧文案随官方 locale 偏好走；已落库的规则正文是用户数据，永不改写                                                                                           |

readme.section: 已知边界
readme.text:
- **没有任何东西自动升格**——一条自行 arm 的规则会把一次噪音上报变成永久指令。
- **不可判定的规则不收敛**：没有干净命中就没有分母，只有人工能退掉它，而注入上限让这一批规则不进上下文。
- **子代理会话被跳过**——再注入一次会让子代理在一批没见过的规则上被计成暴露。
- **卡片是拉取式的**，所以跨重连缓存下来的值按设计就是旧的。
- **证据正文不进卡片**：`lessons()` 读面可以带回一条教训的 `detail`，长度截到 400 字，而卡片只渲染签名与计数器。
- **没有机器翻译**：规则正文与证据是用户数据。
- **可选服务去掉的是能力，不是插件**：没有 `commands` 就没有 `/lessons-digest`，没有 `systemPrompt` 就没有常驻段，没有 `llm` 蒸馏会拒绝，没有 `timer` 就只剩人工评审；没有 `settings` 则条目永不被激活，启动诊断会点名它。
- **一次蒸馏可以局部失败**：没进规则库的卡分开报，而回执绝不会对盘上没有的卡声称「已蒸馏」。模型输出里找不到可解析的 JSON 数组时按硬错误上报，不当成「零条候选」。

readme.section: 常见问题
开发
readme.text:
```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run check   # 类型检查 → lint → client 构建 → host 构建 → 类型 → 测试 → 格式
```

- `test/` 按「桩看不见的那类缺陷」分层：单元测试驱动存储与纯函数；`test/integration/` 驱动真实的 cordis 与 loader，于是服务交出、兄弟条目 `inject` 的解析、激活顺序与舱壁隔离都是量出来的，不是打桩模拟的。
- 两道产物门：`test/build-host.test.ts` 让跨包导入保持为外部裸说明符，`test/dist-size.test.ts` 守住体积预算，于是被内联的依赖不会悄悄过关。`test/publish-manifest.test.ts` 守住发布形态——入口目标都被 `files` 覆盖、没有源文件当入口、`dependencies` 里没有宿主包、`dsh-*` 钉版精确且统一、注释与文档里没有日期。
- 覆盖率阈值是四项指标都 100%，所以新加一个分支就要有一条能走到它的用例。

readme.section: 许可
readme.text:
MIT。源码在 [github.com/JayYuen666/dsh-lesson-loop](https://github.com/JayYuen666/dsh-lesson-loop)。问题请提到那个仓库的 issue tracker。

本包不含任何第三方源码：`host.js` 与 `client.js` 把所有跨包导入都保持为外部裸说明符。运行期依赖各自带自己的许可；[`THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`](./THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md) 记录那条产物边界以及如何复查它。
